description: This file defines a Java interface for a REST client called BankingCoreRestClient, which uses Spring Cloud OpenFeign to communicate with a core banking service. It declares methods for reading account information and performing utility payments by calling specific API endpoints.

classes.name: BankingCoreRestClient
classes.description: A Feign client interface for interacting with core banking REST APIs, including account retrieval and utility payment operations.

methods.name: readAccount
methods.description: Retrieves account information for the specified account number via a GET request.

methods.name: utilityPayment
methods.description: Performs a utility payment transaction by sending a POST request with payment details.
